edition.locus: Documenta Catholica Omnia Canones GR (sources/canones_GR.pdf), p. 2, Canon η´

source_text: Τοὺς δὲ οἴκοις ἀλλοτρίοις ἐπελθεῖν τολμήσαντας, ἐὰν μὲν κατηγορηθέντες ἐλεγχθῶσι, μηδὲ τῆς ἀκροάσεως ἀξιώσῃς, ἐὰν δὲ ἑαυτοὺς ἐξείπωσι καὶ ἀποδῶσιν, ἐν τῇ τῶν ὑποστρεφόντων τάξει ὑποπίπτειν.
orientation: Penance for those who broke into other people's houses: if convicted, they are not admitted even among the hearers; if they confess and make restitution, they kneel with the returning penitents.
pass_a_gloss: Those who dared to come upon others' houses, if being accused they are convicted, may you not count [them] worthy even of the hearing; but if they declare themselves and give back, [they are] to fall under in the order of those returning.

choices.why: To come upon, assail; the setting is the raid.

choices.term: ἐν τῇ τῶν ὑποστρεφόντων τάξει ὑποπίπτειν
choices.english: kneel in the rank of those who are returning
choices.why: ὑποπίπτειν names the kneeling grade; 'turning back' was avoided because in English it can suggest falling away.
rejected: fall down in the order of those turning back

pass_b_english: As for those who dared to raid other people’s houses: if they are accused and convicted, you should not admit them even to the stage of hearing; but if they confess on their own and make restitution, they are to kneel in the rank of those who are returning.
notes: Rubric left out (editorial; it adds 'during the barbarian raid'). ἐπελθεῖν rendered 'raid' (come upon, assail). ἀξιώσῃς is second person singular, addressed to the bishop, hence 'you should not admit them'. ἑαυτοὺς ἐξείπωσι = declare themselves, confess without being charged ('confess on their own'). ἐν τῇ τῶν ὑποστρεφόντων τάξει ὑποπίπτειν as printed: ὑποπίπτειν names the kneeling grade (ὑπόπτωσις, section 11) and ὑποστρέφοντες are 'those who are returning' (the returning penitents; 'turning back' avoided because in English it can suggest falling away); not checked against a second Greek witness. Correction ἐαυτοὺς → ἑαυτοὺς follows the source note. No Scripture.
